Moves the text cursor of [Print](Print) and [Write](Write) to a position in pixels. The position is on the screen and not in the current buffer.

```blitzbasic
;media still fonts/locate.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
Cls
Locate 20, 20
Print "Top left"
Locate 160, 120
Print "Middle"
Locate 100, 220
Print "Bottom"
WaitKey
```

![Locate](media/fonts/locate.png)
@param x  Horizontal position of the cursor in pixels.
@param y  Vertical position of the cursor in pixels.
@gap The position is limited to the window.
